# Repo-owned fast_float snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [fastfloat/fast_float](https://github.com/fastfloat/fast_float) at commit `1ea4f27b2aeee2859a1354a3c24cff52a116cad1`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 61 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE` files are retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
